title: Link upstream catalog
description: Spec 63. The bounded list of exact model ids the key may use, pushed once right after the acknowledgement and again in answer to each catalog request; a catalog replaces the previous one. Each entry is closed: nothing about the acceptor's topology, queue, tenants, nodes or free capacity can ride here, and provenance is only ever reported (passing through a gateway never makes a claim verified). At most 256 entries; a dialer drops a catalog that breaks any bound. A duplicate model_id is not expressible in a schema (uniqueItems compares whole entries) and is refused by the semantic rule in conformance/link_upstream.py. The 256 bound and the integer maximum are placeholders; a measured bound is owed.

model_id.description: The exact model id, never an alias.

max_context_tokens.description: The context the acceptor serves this model at. An entry the acceptor cannot state a context for is omitted, not zero.
